dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Toodaloo was surrendered into care as a stray, so his past behavior in a home enviornment is unknown. Toodaloo has been mostly social with handlers in care, but has intermittently displayed fearfulness, including during his handling assessments. During the knock portion, he began chuffing and lip curling when the assistant returned to the office. When given time, he readily approaches handlers for treats and some petting. Toodaloo has recently begun kennel fighting and leash biting when being returned or taken out of the kennel. Due to these concerns, we recommend that Toodaloo be placed in an adult-only home through a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
